name: initiate_cpr
description: Initiate cardiopulmonary resuscitation for cardiac arrest patients following AHA/ERC guidelines

compression_depth_cm.description: Target compression depth in cm (5-6 for adults)

advanced_airway.description: Whether advanced airway is in place

rhythm_check_interval_min.description: Interval for rhythm checks in minutes (default 2)

when_to_use: Patient found unresponsive with no pulse and no breathing
In-hospital cardiac arrest detected on monitoring
Witnessed cardiac collapse requiring immediate compressions
Pulseless electrical activity detected on ECG monitor

examples.query: Patient found unresponsive in bed, no pulse, monitor shows VFib
Unwitnessed arrest found by nurse, patient in asystole
